name: Amtrak StatusMaps / Track API
tagline: Real-time Amtrak train status and tracking via public StatusMaps endpoints
description: Public Amtrak StatusMaps JSON endpoints used by amtrak.com for live train locations, schedules, and station status. Widely reverse-engineered by third parties; no official public developer portal or key-based API product is published as of 2026.

auth.details: No public API key or OAuth. Browser-facing StatusMaps endpoints historically callable without auth; may use opaque tokens or anti-bot measures. Not a supported developer product.

pricing.free_tier_limits: no official product or published free tier; public map endpoints historically free/unauthenticated

use_cases: get live status for an Amtrak train number
list active Amtrak trains on the map
track train lat/long for a journey
check whether a train is delayed or on time
